title: passiflora moluccana var. glaberrima
intro: Passiflora moluccana var. glaberrima, commonly known as the Malabar passionflower, is a plant species in the Passifloraceae family, native to tropical regions of Asia. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including reducing anxiety and stress, promoting sleep, and alleviating symptoms of menopause. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides that have sedative and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Passiflora moluccana var. glaberrima may also contribute to its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
